description: Doula Services offered under MassHealth Insurance
whatThisIs: As of Spring 2024 Doula Services are now being offered under MassHealth Insurance, subject to MassHealth coverage limitations. Doulas are non-medical staff that help with emotional, informational, and physical support to you and your family based on your unique needs.
relatedLinkExplanation: Having Questions about your MassHealth Coverage? Ombudsman is a free resource that you can use to get more information about what your plan offers.
application: PT-1 must first be referred by your primary care office.
whoItHelps: Expectanting or Currently pregnant individuals looking for extra support in their pregnancy. Or those looking for Postpartum support up to 12 months after their delivery.
whatItHelps: Answer your questions about pregnancy and birth , Can offer information about what to expect at the hospital and non-medical comfort measures for labor and delivery
whatToKnow: Doula coverage is subject to MassHealth coverage limitations, for MassHealth members while they are pregnant, during delivery, and up to 12 months after the pregnancy ends, Dual’s can specialize in Pregnancy, Birth, Postpartum, Abortion, Pregnancy/infant loss
name: MassHealth Doula Services Program
